title: hrms.time.leave.applied
description: Leave's return leg (ADR-0006 §12): an approval decision was applied to the request. `outcome` is `applied` for an approval *and* for a rejection, and `status` says which. `failed` means the transition had become illegal, and `failure_reason` says why. The request's dates travel with it, so a consumer counting days on leave needs no second read.
$comment: Ahead of the producer (ADR-0020 slice I9): services/leave/app/services.py:_publish_leave_applied does not emit status, employee_id, leave_type_id, start_date, end_date, total_half_days yet. Until that slice merges, a real payload fails this schema on exactly those fields. That is the forcing function, not a bug. Every other field is emitted today.
